UserPreference.title: User Preference Settings
UserPreference.description: Custom companion layout preferences, themes, and configuration flags.

userId.description: User account ID matching Firebase Auth UID

themeColor.description: Selected visual theme atmosphere (violet, crimson, celestial, gold, rose, charcoal)

WorkspaceItem.title: Workspace Saved Item
WorkspaceItem.description: Reference pointers to frequently-accessed Google Sheets or Google Docs.

name.description: The custom name of the Google Doc or Google Sheet

url.description: Full document or spreadsheet URL link

WorkspaceLog.title: Workspace Interaction Log
WorkspaceLog.description: Durable audit log tracking all edits, emails sent, or documents read by Myraa on Google Workspace.

actionType.description: The exact action performed, e.g. 'Gmail Draft Sent', 'Google Doc Created', 'Row Appended'

details.description: Textual context summary detailing the action payload

ConversationMessage.title: Conversation Message
ConversationMessage.description: Raw chat messages stored permanently for the user, recording conversations with Myraa.

ConversationSummary.title: Conversation Summary
ConversationSummary.description: Summaries of conversations highlighting key topics, decisions, tasks, facts, and milestones.

LongTermMemory.title: Long Term User Memory
LongTermMemory.description: Refined factual/behavioral recollections about the user extracted by Myraa's cognitive engine.

Project.title: Project Definition
Project.description: A structured project that the user has shared details about.

Task.title: Task Definition
Task.description: Tasks created during conversations or explicit requests.

Reminder.title: Reminder Definition
Reminder.description: Reminders set by the user during discussions.

/users/{userId}.description: Root document containing individual settings and companion styles.

/users/{userId}/workspace_items/{itemId}.description: Favorite Google Drive Sheets and Docs that are managed by the user.

/users/{userId}/workspace_logs/{logId}.description: Audit trails for Sheets, Doc edits, and emails sent on behalf of the user.

/users/{userId}/conversations/{conversat.description: Raw chat messages stored permanently for the user, grouped by conversation ID.

/users/{userId}/summaries/{summaryId}.description: Aggregated conversation summaries generated at periodic intervals.

/users/{userId}/memories/{memoryId}.description: Durable extracted user memories across multiple categories.

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: Structured project files managed inside Myraa memory core.

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: Action items or checklist tasks assigned during chats.
